<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a body part that can be extracted from a corpse at the [[preparation place|autopsy table]]. Upon removal, it has the effect of adding one Red Skull {{Skull|red}}. In addition, similar to most other anatomy and theology items, it can be studied at the [[Study table]] for a {{Techpoint|Blue}} reward. For more information, see [[corpses]]. They're also utilized in the buildings of various constructs when using the [[Dark design desk]].

==Quest==
===Bring me a skull===
After talking at length with [[Gerry]], he will eventually inform you of the [[Astrologer]]. Upon meeting him, he will ask you to retrieve a {{PAGENAME}} from a corpse. Returning with one will kick off the Astrologer's quest-line, and open up the potential for trade.
